items.value: Official Retirement Day
Today is your last day of work. How do you feel?
Have a small party with family
I had a cozy party with my loved ones.
Celebrate with colleagues
It was a meaningful farewell with those I worked with.
Stay home and rest because you feel tired
After all these years, I can finally truly rest.
First Pension Received
You just received your first pension payment.
Put it into savings
I need to plan my expenses for the future.
Use it to travel
This is a chance to take the trips I've always dreamed of.
Give a portion to children and grandchildren
Seeing my children and grandchildren happy is my happiness.
Go for a general health check-up
It's time for a routine health check-up.
Do everything the doctor says
Health is the most precious asset, I need to take care of it.
Skip a few tests
I feel fine, no need for too many tests.
Postpone it for later because you feel tired
I'll go for a check-up another day.
Participate in volunteer activities
You are considering participating in a local volunteer activity.
Help at the library
The work at the library is quiet and meaningful.
Help at a nursing home
Chatting with other elderly friends brings me joy.
Help distribute food for charity
Helping those in need makes my life feel more meaningful.
First long trip after retirement
This is your first long trip after retiring.
Go on a cross-state road trip
The trip was amazing with beautiful roadside scenery.
Go on a cruise
Enjoying the sea and luxury services is so relaxing.
Fly to Europe
Exploring new cultures is an unforgettable experience.
Invited to an amusement park by grandchildren
The grandchildren invite you to an amusement park.
Go on all the thrill rides
I feel like I'm 20 years younger!
Just stand and watch
Seeing the grandchildren happy makes me happy too.
Sit and rest because you can't keep up
My health doesn't allow me to run around much anymore.
Join a local seniors' club
You decide to join the local seniors' club.
Participate in dancing
Dancing makes me feel healthy and vibrant.
Play chess with the group
The challenging chess games keep my mind sharp.
Just sit and listen to stories because you're tired
I prefer listening to people talk.
Go to a supermarket sale with friends
Friends invite you to go bargain hunting at the supermarket.
Shop enthusiastically
I got a lot of great deals.
Just browse the aisles
I just went to look around for fun.
Sit and wait for friends to shop because your legs are tired
Walking a lot makes my legs tired.
Old class reunion
You attend a class reunion after many years apart.
Chat enthusiastically
It was great to reminisce about old memories with friends.
Sing with old friends
We sang the songs of our time together.
Sit and listen because you don't remember much
My memory isn't as good as it used to be.
Weekend family dinner
The family gathers for a weekend dinner.
Help with the cooking
I still want to prepare meals for the whole family.
Play with grandchildren
Playing with my grandchildren is my greatest joy.
Sit and rest, letting the children and grandchildren handle it
It's time to let the younger generation take over.
Feeling empty after the retirement party
After retiring, you feel empty and lacking purpose.
Go for a walk
A walk helped clear my head.
Call friends
Talking with friends made me feel better.
Sit alone and think
I need time to adjust to my new life.
Realizing money is not enough for long-term expenses
You realize that your pension might not be enough for long-term expenses.
Find a part-time job
I'm still healthy enough to do some light work.
Seek financial advice
A professional helped me create a reasonable spending plan.
Save as much as possible
I need to tighten my belt even more.
Discovering an illness that needs treatment
The health check-up results show you have an illness that requires treatment.
Follow the doctor's advice
I trust modern medicine.
Try herbal medicine
I want to try natural remedies.
Hesitate to get treatment
I feel scared and don't want to face it yet.
Unable to keep up with volunteering
You realize that volunteering requires more energy than you thought.
Ask to leave
I asked to leave to preserve my health.
Only provide light support
I switched to lighter tasks.
Stop completely
I decided to stop volunteering altogether.
Fatigue from a busy travel schedule
The packed schedule of the trip makes you feel exhausted.
Rest more
I spent more time resting.
Reduce the number of trips
We canceled a few destinations to have a more relaxing trip.
End the trip early
Health comes first, we decided to go home early.
Getting heatstroke at the park
Due to the hot weather, you got heatstroke and need to rest.
Find a cool place
I found a shady spot to rest.
Drink water
Drinking plenty of water helped me feel better.
Go home and rest
I decided to go home to rest completely.
Initial difficulty integrating
You find it difficult to integrate with other members of the club.
Persevere
I persevered and gradually made friends.
Find a smaller group
I found a smaller group that suited me better.
Stop participating
Maybe this place is not for me.
Missed many promotions
Because your legs were tired, you missed out on many good sale items.
Ask a friend to buy for you
My friend was kind enough to buy a few items for me.
Buy online
Online shopping is much more convenient.
Skip it
Anyway, I don't really need them.
Feeling lonely after the reunion
After the class reunion, you feel an indescribable loneliness.
Call a friend
Talking with a close friend helped me feel better.
Write in a diary
Writing down my thoughts helped me release my emotions.
Sit sadly
I was lost in old memories.
Feeling no longer the central figure
You realize that you are no longer the center of the family.
Proactively offer small help
I find joy in helping my children and grandchildren with small things.
Talk to your children and grandchildren
I shared my feelings with my children.
Silently accept
This is the natural law of life.
Daily morning
A normal morning for a retiree.
Go for a walk
A morning walk makes me feel refreshed.
Sit and read the newspaper
Keeping up with the news is a good habit.
Stay home and rest because you're tired
I don't feel well today.
Watch TV
You are spending time watching TV.
Watch the news
I always want to know what's happening in the world.
Watch old movies
Old movies bring back many good memories.
Nod off while watching
I fell asleep without realizing it.
Play with grandchildren
You are spending time playing with your grandchildren.
Take the grandchildren out to play
We had a fun day at the park.
Tell fairy tales
The grandchildren love listening to my stories.
Sit and watch the grandchildren play because you're tired
Just watching them play is enough.
Meet an old friend
You accidentally meet an old friend.
Chat over tea
We sat down and reminisced about old stories.
Go for a walk together
A short walk was enough to rekindle our friendship.
Sit and listen to your friend's stories
I prefer listening to my friend's stories.
Go to the market
It's time to buy groceries for the week.
Buy everything needed
I bought everything I needed.
Buy less to carry lightly
I don't want to carry heavy things.
Sit at a cafe and wait because you're tired
I asked my children to go shopping for me.
Go to church/temple
You go to a place of worship to find peace.
Attend the main service
I feel at peace.
Talk to fellow believers
Chatting with people of the same faith is interesting.
Rest in the courtyard
The fresh air here is so pleasant.
Grandchild's birthday
Today is a grandchild's birthday.
Give a gift
My small gift made them very happy.
Take commemorative photos
The photos will preserve this moment.
Sit and watch the grandchildren have fun
Their joy is my joy.
Visit children living far away
You are considering visiting your child who lives far away.
Go by bus
The trip was a bit tiring but worth it.
Go by plane
Flying is faster and more convenient.
Decide not to go because you're tired
I'll wait for them to visit me.
Hot sunny afternoon
The afternoon weather is very hot and humid.
Take a nap
A nap helps me regain energy.
Drink cool water
A glass of cool water is so refreshing.
Rest all afternoon
I don't want to do anything in this weather.
Go to the park
You take a walk in the nearby park.
Practice tai chi
Tai chi helps my body become more flexible.
Sit and talk
I had a pleasant conversation with some old friends.
Sit quietly and enjoy the scenery
Watching nature is so peaceful.
Go to the village festival
The village is holding a traditional festival.
Watch cultural performances
The cultural performances were excellent.
Eat snacks
The snacks here are delicious.
Rest under a tree's shade
The festival atmosphere is so lively.
Join a new class (drawing/music)
You decide to join a new class like drawing or music.
Learn enthusiastically
Learning a new skill makes me feel young again.
Try a few sessions
I tried a few sessions to see if I liked it.
Quit because it's difficult
It's harder than I thought.
Periodic medical check-up
It's time for a periodic medical check-up.
Do all the tests
I want to be sure about my health.
Do half of them
I only did the most necessary tests.
Cancel because you're tired
I don't feel like going for a check-up today.
Rainy day
A sad and gloomy rainy day.
Sit and read a book
Reading by a rainy window is a refined pleasure.
Take a nap
The sound of rain is the best lullaby.
Sit and watch the rain
I just sat quietly and watched the raindrops.
Visit relatives
You visit relatives who live far away.
Have a pleasant chat
Meeting relatives is always a happy occasion.
Eat with them
The family meal was so cozy.
Sit quietly and listen to stories
I enjoy listening to everyone's stories.
Watch sports
You are watching a sports match on TV.
Cheer for your favorite team
The match was so exciting!
Talk with friends
Watching with friends is much more fun.
Nod off in the middle
I fell asleep without realizing it.
Insomnia
You can't sleep at night.
Count sheep
I counted up to 1000 sheep and was still awake.
Drink milk
A warm glass of milk helps me sleep better.
Sit quietly and wait for morning
Another long night.
Community festival
The community where you live is holding a festival.
Participate enthusiastically
I had a great time.
Take a walk around
I just took a walk to see the atmosphere.
Rest early because you're tired
I don't have enough energy to participate for long.
Receive a surprise gift
You receive a surprise gift from an old friend.
Joyful
The gift is so meaningful!
Moved
I was very touched by your kindness.
Shy
I don't know what to do in return.
Share food with grandchildren
You have a tasty snack and the grandchildren are watching.
Give the grandchildren a lot
I save the best part for the grandchildren.
Share equally
Everyone gets a piece.
Keep a small portion for yourself
I want to eat a little too.
